title: Arcane Surge before Surge of Power (restore) vs late (current) at 5.6k and 10k
question: Does buying Arcane Surge before Surge of Power raise Power Surge damage and storm damage at 5.6k-18k as the model says?
hypothesis: H-L4: at 10k souls, storm per bot +37% and Power Surge chain damage on 4 bots higher with Arcane early (spirit invest 4.8k, +20 spirit on the next cast after a dash-jump). Equal from 18.4k.

arms.name: RES_10k
arms.notes: dash-jump (cast jump + cast alt?) before cast 3 / cast 4

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: give items; enemies 4 220 8; fetch 350; cast reload 2.5
cast jump 0.2 (dash-jump approximation; verify Arcane buff in 'mods'); cast 3 0.3; fire 8

metrics.name: power_surge_dmg
metrics.how: damage csv ability Power Surge, all bots, 8 s fire

decision.rule: RES beats CUR by >=15% on both metrics supports the restore

blockedIfNo: dash-jump op (cast jump + cast alt untested as dash-jump)
